Features

Everything You Need to Run Your Dealership

From lead handling to inventory updates, SwiftDealer makes routine dealership work faster, cleaner, and far less frustrating.

Stock Management

Easily track and manage your entire vehicle inventory with real-time updates and detailed reporting.

Sales & CRM

Track leads, manage customer relationships, and close deals faster with our integrated CRM system.

Prep Management

Streamline service bookings, manage technician schedules, and track parts inventory efficiently.

Dealer Websites

Manage all financial aspects of your dealership, from invoicing to reporting, with UK tax compliance built-in.

Smart Calendar

Stay compliant with UK regulations including FCA requirements, GDPR, and consumer protection laws.

Reporting & Analytics

Gain valuable insights into your dealership's performance with comprehensive reports and analytics dashboards.
